name: Buff Limits
author: Sateriok
description: Sets 2-hour durations on buffer-NPC buffs and on perma-uptime class self buffs like War Cry. Burst skills such as Frenzy are untouched. Applied in memory at startup; no files edited.

name: Class Master
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a class master NPC that changes a player's profession at levels 20, 40 and 76, with an adena price for each change.

name: Preset Buffer
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran NPC that gives a full fighter or mage buff preset in one click.
